policy.scope: environment-only ambient motion over a fixed approved still

copyrightSafety.note: Both videos derive only from their pinned project-owned generated stills and deterministic locally drawn environmental overlays. They use no external footage, artwork, logos, music, speech, or other audio.

workflow.generator: local System.Drawing overlay frames plus FFmpeg compositing
workflow.seed: not applicable; deterministic geometry and frame timing
workflow.playback: explicit click only; muted; playsinline; autoplay false; loop false
workflow.temporalRule: One forward progression from frame 0 through frame 131; no reverse segment, ping-pong return, repeated pulse, crossfade back to frame 0, autoplay, or loop.

buriolestes-schultzi-candelaria-charcoal.motionLayer: Three broad, soft gray ground-haze fields drift once upward and slightly rightward through the charcoal foreground while the complete Buriolestes, runoff channel, vegetation, camera, and crop remain fixed.
buriolestes-schultzi-candelaria-charcoal.prompt: M0 environment-event test for ages five to fourteen: preserve the approved Buriolestes Candelaria macro-charcoal composite exactly, including the complete small animal at right, both forelimbs, both hind limbs, continuous tail, diagonal runoff, plants, charcoal fragments, camera, crop, scale and palette; animate only broad low-contrast ground haze over the empty charcoal foreground at left; move all haze centers continuously upward and slightly rightward for 132 frames at 24 fps; keep every effect pixel inside x 25 to 454 and y 250 to 494 and keep the animal outside the larger protected exclusion; prohibit fire, flame, falling ash, fleeing, distress, head, jaw, eye, limb, body, tail, plant, water, camera or zoom motion, reverse motion, ping-pong return, repeated pulses, loop, fade back, text, logo, watermark or audio.
buriolestes-schultzi-candelaria-charcoal.evidenceBoundary: The macro-charcoal locality near Pinheiro Machado and the Buriolestes-bearing Buriol outcrop are separate localities. This region-scale composite and its low ground haze do not claim a shared bed, the same wildfire or day, direct witnessing, escape, distress, or immediate postfire survival.

motionQa.note: The haze remains low over the left charcoal foreground, advances in one direction, and never touches the animal. First-to-last decoded comparison keeps every significant change inside the effect rectangle.

ceratosaurus-nasicornis-horsetail-dawn-w.motionLayer: Three restrained elliptical water rings expand once from open foreground water below and left of the fixed lowered snout while the complete Ceratosaurus, horsetails, shoreline, sky, camera, and crop remain fixed.
ceratosaurus-nasicornis-horsetail-dawn-w.prompt: M0 solo-scene test for ages five to fourteen: preserve the approved dawn Ceratosaurus poster exactly, including the lowered nasal-horned head, continuous neck and torso, exactly two connected hind limbs with separate feet, uninterrupted tail, horsetail forelimb occlusion, shoreline, sky, camera, crop, scale and palette; animate only three thin low-contrast elliptical rings in open foreground water below and left of the snout; expand the rings continuously outward for 132 frames at 24 fps without reset or disappearance; keep every effect pixel inside x 0 to 299 and y 410 to 469 and outside the complete animal ROI; prohibit ingestion claims, jaw, tongue, throat, head, neck, eye, limb, body, tail, plant, sky, camera or zoom motion, splashing, reverse motion, ping-pong return, repeated pulses, loop, fade back, text, logo, watermark or audio.
ceratosaurus-nasicornis-horsetail-dawn-w.evidenceBoundary: The source drinking posture and the expanding foreground rings are behavior and water-surface reconstruction hypotheses. The clip does not prove ingestion, swallowing, a particular water depth, exact dawn conditions, or the animal's response to the rings.

motionQa.note: The rings expand once through open foreground water and stay below the animal. First-to-last decoded comparison keeps every significant change inside the effect rectangle.
